map.年用电量 W 由功率 P、日均运行 t 与年运行天数 d 计算；按节能率 η 得: Annual consumption W is from power P, daily run t, and annual days d; at saving rate η get annual saving ΔW, times price c for annual cost saving, times 0.785 kgCO₂/kWh for carbon reduction, payback = retrofit investment I / annual cost saving.
map.💡 公式：年用电量 W = P×t×d (kWh)；年节电量 ΔW = W×η/: 💡 Formula: annual consumption W = P×t×d (kWh); annual saving ΔW = W×η/100; annual cost saving = ΔW×c; carbon reduction = ΔW×0.785 (kgCO₂); payback = I / annual cost saving (years).

map.节能改造立项：输入功率、运行时间与节能率，算年节电与回收期: Retrofit initiation: enter power, run time, and saving rate to compute annual saving and payback.
map.碳排核算：按节电量折算 CO₂ 减排量，用于 ESG 报表: Carbon accounting: convert saving to CO₂ reduction for ESG reports.
map.算法：年用电量 = 功率×日运行小时×年运行天数；年节电量 = 年用电量×节能率: Algorithm: annual consumption = power × daily hours × annual days; annual saving = annual consumption × saving rate / 100; annual cost saving = annual saving × price; carbon reduction = annual saving × 0.785 (kgCO₂); payback = investment / annual cost saving (years), months = payback × 12; 10-year net = annual cost saving × 10; 10-year ROI = (annual cost saving × 10 − investment) / investment × 100; post-retrofit power = power × (1 − saving rate/100); payback <1 excellent, <2 great, <3 good, <5 fair, else long.
map.例：55kW 设备、日运行 12h、年运行 300 天、节能率 25%、电价 0: Example: 55 kW equipment, 12 h/day, 300 days/year, saving 25%, price 0.75, investment 80000 → annual 198000 kWh, saving 49500 kWh, annual cost saving 37125, carbon 38857.5 kg (38.86 t), payback 2.15 yr (25.9 months), 10-year net 371250, ROI 364.06%, post power 41.25 kW, rated good.
map.碳减排系数 0.785 从哪来？: Where does the 0.785 carbon factor come from?
map.按全国电网平均排放因子约 0.785 kgCO₂/kWh 估算；使用绿电或区域电: Estimated from the national grid average emission factor ~0.785 kgCO₂/kWh; with green power or large regional-grid differences, substitute your region's latest published factor.
map.节能率怎么取才不虚高？: How to pick a saving rate without overstating?
map.应以同工况实测或厂家型式试验数据为准，避免直接取铭牌最大节能率；变频改造还要扣除: Use measured same-duty or manufacturer type-test data, not the nameplate maximum; VFD retrofit must also deduct the drive's own loss (~2%~4%).
